claim: Overall oocyte quality declines with aging.

claim: The age-related reduction in serum CNP concentration is highly correlated with decreased oocyte quality.

claim: CNP treatment improved cytoplasmic maturation of aged oocytes as assessed by spindle/chromosome morphology.
